definitions.explanation: Leave taken from work to care for a young child, available to both mothers and fathers under Japanese law.

examples.japanese: {夫|おっと}も{育児休暇|いくじきゅうか}を{取|と}ることにした。
examples.english: My husband decided to take parental leave too.

examples.japanese: {育児休暇|いくじきゅうか}は{最長|さいちょう}1{年間|ねんかん}{取得|しゅとく}できる。
examples.english: Parental leave can be taken for up to one year.

examples.japanese: {男性|だんせい}の{育児休暇|いくじきゅうか}{取得率|しゅとくりつ}が{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: The rate of men taking parental leave is increasing.

examples.japanese: {育児休暇|いくじきゅうか}を{取|と}りたいが、{職場|しょくば}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}で{言|い}い{出|だ}しにくい。
examples.english: I want to take parental leave, but the workplace atmosphere makes it hard to speak up.

examples.japanese: {育児休暇|いくじきゅうか}から{復帰|ふっき}した{後|あと}、{時短勤務|じたんきんむ}に{切|き}り{替|か}えた。
examples.english: After returning from parental leave, I switched to reduced working hours.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {育児|いくじ} (childcare) + {休暇|きゅうか} (leave, vacation).

LEGAL NAME: {育児|いくじ}・{介護休業法|かいごきゅうぎょうほう} (Childcare and Caregiver Leave Act) officially calls it {育児休業|いくじきゅうぎょう}.

ABBREVIATION: {育休|いくきゅう} (colloquial).

JAPAN'S SYSTEM:
- Available until child is 1 year old (extendable to 2 years in some cases)
- Both parents can take leave
- Partial wage replacement through employment insurance
- Job protection during leave period

RELATED LEAVE TYPES:
- {産休|さんきゅう}: maternity leave (before/after birth)
- {産前休暇|さんぜんきゅうか}: prenatal leave
- {産後休暇|さんごきゅうか}: postnatal leave
- {介護休暇|かいごきゅうか}: family care leave

CURRENT TRENDS:
- Government promoting "{イクメン|いくめん}" (hands-on fathers)
- Increasing male participation in childcare
- Corporate culture slowly changing
